learning_outcomes.text: Analyze and design systems in the field of machinery and industrial construction.
Express and communicate ideas related to the construction of machines, mechanisms, and industrial structures.
Master common calculations and tools in the field of machine and industrial building construction.

syllabus_topics: Columns with different types of supports
assessment_rules: The final grade for the course will be the weighted result of three evaluation activities: Partial written test (Topics 1 and 2) 20%, Final written exam (Topics 3, 4, 5 and 6) 60%, and Group activity (final project) 20%. To pass the course, a minimum overall grade of 5/10 must be obtained. Grades for the partial test and group activity are not recoverable in the final exam, but are recoverable in the resit exam. Resit assessment consists of a single written exam covering the entire course content (Topics 1 to 6), weighted at 100% of the final grade. In this modality, the three continuous assessment activities will not contribute to the final grade. To pass the course, a minimum grade of 5/10 must be obtained.
